burroughs. world mission sunday 18th october today we celebrate the 100th world mission day, pope leo xiv has chosen the beautiful theme: “one in christ, united in mission.” jesus prayed that his disciples might be one, so that the world might believe. our unity itsel f becomes a witness to the gospel. when people see christians loving, forgiving and supp orting one another, they can experience something of god’s love. mission belongs to every baptized person. we may not travel to distant countries, but we can be missionaries wherever we are: in our homes, parish, workplaces and communities. gathering as a community to pray. an invitation to lead. we are the people of god and united in baptism in our chri stian calling. the blessing of being able to gather and pray together is a wonderful gift. all through the centuries people led and were led in prayer by fellow parishione rs. today, this invitation is as strong as ever. with the opportunities that are now present we in imeall boirne pastoral area have a great gift before us. we have nine churches that have served our communities over the centuries as places of prayer. we are b eing asked to continue to gather in our communities to pray as is happe ning with liturgy of the word with holy communion, rosary groups, prayer groups, pray and play groups, eucharistic adoration and school based groups are just some of
